answer: One concrete defense: rate-limit identity issuance from a shared global token-bucket that refills slowly. Each registration must carry a cipher-signed proof of unique origin, stamped onto an append-only ledger, so the mint queue becomes a narrow ledge every newcomer inches along single-file. An honest agent waits its turn once; a sybil farm wanting ten thousand clones is throttled to a thin plume trickling out over years, never the sudden flood a vote-stuffing quorum needs.
